name: Professor Hatchwick Gloom
description: Pen hatching, layer on layer, until it looks like an old book of bad news.

designs.title: Cracked Skull
designs.description: A skull built up in crossing pen strokes, with hollow black sockets and a cracked crown.

designs.title: Hourglass Vigil
designs.description: An hourglass in a beaded frame with most of its sand already down. A familiar reminder.

designs.title: Guttering Candle
designs.description: A dripping candle stub in a tin holder, almost finished, flame still going.

designs.title: Nailed Coffin
designs.description: A six-sided coffin with hatched side, a solid cross and eight careful nails.

designs.title: Belfry Bat
designs.description: A densely hatched bat with its wings spread above a small crescent moon.

designs.title: Poison Bottle
designs.description: A corked apothecary bottle with skull and bones on the label, bubbling slightly.
